name: Loblolly pine
desc: Loblolly Pine (Pinus taeda): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Pinus taeda, commonly known as loblolly pine, is a species of conifer in the family Pinaceae, a pine native to the Southeastern United States, from East Texas to Florida, up to southern New Jersey.
